title: Derived record of one innovation (prompt extract-v1)
description: What an extraction worker writes to .local/pipeline/derived/<id>.json. Closed lists (target_groups, domains, implementer_types, setting, scale, cost_band, time_to_implement, evidence_level) are enforced by scripts/derive-records.py from data/taxonomies.json, the single source of truth; word limits, grounding and personal-data rules are enforced there too. See docs/innovation-record.md.

generated_by.description: Model id of the worker, as given by the coordinator, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5

source_fingerprint.description: Copied from the source record's 'fingerprint'; a mismatch marks the derived record stale

summary_pl.description: What it is, for whom, how; at most 60 words

problem_pl.description: The problem it answers; at most 60 words

mechanism_pl.description: How it works, concretely; at most 60 words

index_card_pl.description: One line for the matching index; at most 30 words

origin_place_pl.description: A town or gmina named in the source, copied verbatim; null when the source names none

problem_pl.description: Anchoring quote of the problem paragraph; required from extract-v2 on

mechanism_pl.description: Anchoring quote of the mechanism paragraph; required from extract-v2 on

notes_pl.description: Doubts for the reviewer; at most 40 words; null when none

basis.description: quote: the source states it (quote required); inference: judged from what the source describes; unknown: the source gives nothing

quote.description: Verbatim words from the source record's text_pl, at most 20 words; required when basis is quote
